description: Phase 6D.5 held-candidate allowlist proposals only. Do NOT apply or approve automatically. Review, then use scripts/set_source_patterns.py and the registry approval workflow after explicit human approval.

proposals.name: BAMF — Work / employment for third-country nationals
proposals.rationale: Current allowlist is filename-scoped to arbeit-node.html and excludes linked detail pages under .../Arbeit/ (e.g. Fachkraft, ICT, Sonstige). A single directory-prefix pattern admits those child pages while remaining under the Arbeit topic branch.

notes: Pattern uses Arbeit* after the fixed ZuwandererDrittstaaten/ path — not a bare /Arbeit* anywhere on bamf.de.
Does not widen the approved BAMF hub seed (11033), which remains filename-scoped to zuwandererdrittstaaten-node.html.
German-language /DE/ trees remain out of scope.

proposals.recommendation: Apply proposed_patterns, then approve source 11034 in a later phase. Do not approve with the current filename-only pattern.

proposals.name: BAMF — Family reunification for third-country nationals
proposals.rationale: Same filename-scoped issue as work: linked Familie child pages are outside familie-node.html*. Directory prefix Familie* under ZuwandererDrittstaaten covers the family topic tree only.

notes: Pattern is scoped under ZuwandererDrittstaaten/Familie* — cannot match unrelated /Familie paths elsewhere on the site.
Does not overlap the Arbeit proposal (11034) or the approved hub (11033).

proposals.recommendation: Apply proposed_patterns, then approve source 11035 later. Do not approve with the current filename-only pattern.

proposals.name: IND — Naturalisation

linked_from_seed_page.title_hint: U wordt Nederlander. Wat mag en moet u doen? 6075

proposals.rationale: The naturalisation HTML seed links two official application/info PDFs. The EN page points at /nl/formulieren/{id}.pdf; matching EN files exist at /en/forms/{id}.pdf (HTTP 200). Enumerate exact PDF URLs instead of opening /en/forms/*.

admits: Naturalisation HTML under the seed prefix
Exactly two form PDFs: 5013.pdf and 6075.pdf under /en/forms/
notes: No wildcard under /en/forms/ — avoids unrestricted forms-directory expansion.
Optional later: add NL /nl/formulieren/5013.pdf and 6075.pdf only if bilingual storage is desired; EN equivalents are preferred for MVP language scope.

proposals.recommendation: Either (a) approve HTML-only with current pattern, or (b) apply proposed_patterns (HTML + two exact EN PDFs) then approve. Do not approve a forms-directory wildcard.

australia_extraction_note.blocker: SharePoint/ASP.NET visa pages leave <main> empty; guidance HTML is embedded in a PageSchema JSON hidden input.

fix_landed.behavior: When DOM blocks < 2 or main text is short, recover HTML fragments from hidden-input / application/json payloads; skip siteData menu blobs; re-walk fragments into headings/paragraphs/lists.

australia_extraction_note.recommendation: Re-validate AU candidates 11023–11027 with extractor 1.3.0 before approval. Do not approve in this phase.
